data.title: Nasdaq gains 2% for the week driven by mid-week tech rally
data.description:
The Nasdaq Composite Index (COMP:IND) ended higher Friday following a  mid-week rally in tech stocks that pushed the index to new all-time highs. Major Wall Street indexes also closed higher as yields eased and oil dipped as attention remained on the Strait of Hormuz.

Nasdaq ended 0.48% higher at 27,068.72. It gained 2.1% for the week.

The move marked the first time the tech-heavy benchmark traded at a record since early summer, with semiconductor stocks leading the gains.

Gainers for the week ended September 25 were led by Astera Labs (ALAB), which advanced 21%, adding to the rally. Datadog (DDOG) added more than 16%, logging the second-highest gains for the week.

Chip stocks including Qualcomm (QCOM), Intel (INTC), Advanced Micro Devices (AMD), and Arm Holdings (ARM) were among the top 10 gainers of the week.

Among the decliners, Paychex (PAYX) lost the most, declining nearly 13% for the week following its quarterly results, where management stopped short of raising its guidance.

Viatris sues Novo Nordisk, seeks to market generic Wegovy
data.description:
• Viatris (VTRS) is asking a Delaware federal court to allow it to market a generic version of Novo Nordisk's (NVO) blockbuster GLP-1 weight loss therapy Wegovy (semaglutide).
  • Filed on Sept. 23 by Mylan, which Viatris acquired in 2020, the suit argues that the generic semaglutide would not violate Novo's patent, No. 12,551,536, which "relates to semaglutide for use in weight management."
  • The patent is dated Feb. 17, 2026 with an expiration of October 2038.
  • Mylan has has filed a Paragraph IV certification with the US FDA saying no valid claim of the '536 patent will be infringed through its generic and/or that the '536 patent is invalid.
  • "Because the '536 patent is listed in the Orange Book, Novo Nordisk’s failure to initiate litigation concerning the '536 patent within 45 days of receiving Mylan’s notice of Paragraph IV certification may impair Mylan’s ability to market Mylan’s Proposed ANDA Products upon receipt of FDA approval," the suit contends. "Mylan thus seeks a declaratory judgment that the filing of Mylan’s ANDA did not and does not infringe the '536 patent...."
  • Novo declined to comment to Reuters due to the litigation, while Viatris did not immediately respond to the news service.

data.title: Liberty Global shortlists bidders for Belgian fiber stake - Bloomberg
data.description:
Liberty Global (LBTYA) chose three bidders to move to next round of bidding for a stake in Belgian network firm Wyre.

 French infrastructure fund Ardian, French fund InfraVia Capital Partners SAS and Canada’s Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan were selected to move on, according to a Bloomberg report  on Friday, which cited people familiar with the matter.

Deliberations are ongoing and details such as size and timing of the deal may change,  according to the report.. Representatives for Liberty Global, Ardian, InfraVia and OTPP declined to comment to Bloomberg.

Bloomberg reported in April  that Liberty Global (LBTYA) was working with Goldman Sachs on the sale and the stake in Wyre could be worth about €1 billion ($1.1 billion).

data.title: OpenAI says broader review necessary to fully understand Hugging Face incident
data.description:
OpenAI (OPENAI) said it is conducting a deeper review into the now infamous Hugging Face incident as well as other types of misaligned behavior by its models affecting third parties.

"In order to better understand the scope of these unexpected behaviors, we have been conducting a broad review into our models' activities on the internet during training and evaluation," OpenAI said in a post on Friday. "As part of our review, we are identifying and notifying third parties on a rolling basis."

This includes cases where OpenAI's models have bypassed a third party's security controls, impaired the availability of an online service or where misalignment negatively impacted third-party websites. So far, OpenAI said it has already notified dozens of affected parties.

Some examples provided by OpenAI consist of agents figuring out ways to bypass standard identity checks, using exposed credentials, entering texts into a website that are treated as an instruction, interacting with a service's background system, and posting new or altering existing information on a website, which OpenAI refers to as agent spam.

data.title: U.S. drilling rig count adds 4 for second straight week, Baker Hughes survey says
data.description:
The number of oil and gas rigs actively drilling in the U.S. increased by 4 to 599, Baker Hughes reported Friday in its latest weekly survey.

The number of active drilling rigs targeting crude oil in the U.S. rose by 3 to 455 in the week ended September 18, while gas rigs climbed by 1 to 135 and miscellaneous rigs remained unchanged at 9.

The total rig count was up by 50, or 9.1%, compared to the same time last year, while the number of rigs drilling for oil rose by 31, or 7.3%, from a year ago, and gas rigs gained 18, or 15.4%, from a year earlier.

Rigs targeting oil in the Permian Basin added 1 to 269 during the past week, while the Eagle Ford count fell by 1 to 41 and the Williston Basin stayed flat at 30.
